## J2ME-NXX v0.8.11

- 3D (M3G) rendering now uses a second CPU core: about 1.4x faster on top of v0.8.10, with identical output.
- New "CPU boost" option in Settings → System (off by default): raises the Switch CPU from 1020 to 1785 MHz while an app runs. Faster heavy/3D games, but warmer console and more battery use.
